scope.scope: Goals 1–5: digital hardware/interface confirmation, backend dispatch, packet transactions, feature contracts, persistence and hazards
scope.userIdentity: User confirms standard AULA F75, not HE, not display Pro
scope.authorization: Digital investigation and documentation only; user asleep; no requests for physical verification. No target execution, HID Get/Set reports, settings changes, resets, flashing, installs.
scope.coordination: Each agent owns unique request files, output variables, evidence files, docs. Separate runner sessions safe immutable target analyses. Native file tools for writes. Capture stdout through REPL; parse JSON lines and export successful Evidence. No secrets/ambient environment dumps.
scope.validation: Cite addresses/evidence IDs, distinguish static proof from live validation, inspect assembly where pseudocode ABI/arrays/control flow suspect. Do not infer command safety from names.
scope.safetyReaffirmed: User explicitly prioritizes new keyboard safety. Zero keyboard commands/device IO, no target launch, reset, firmware, settings, or connection changes. Metadata/static analysis only.

Regex mode uses Java Pattern semantics. Matcher or compiler stack exhaustion returns a resource constraint without closing the session; literal mode avoids regex recursion and returns complete matching values.
